name: Tis' the Seasoning
tagline: A handpicked selection of salts & spices!
description:
We know, horrible play on words - too easy. It doesn't change the fact that we all need salt & seasoning to survive. Think of this collection as a food survival kit. If the recipient is to take a beautiful piece of beef, pork, or fish, or that perfect grilled vegetable or pasta and transform it into something memorable, he/she is going to need some help. Break out a full arsenal of finishing salts, herbs, ground peppers & aromatics and they will be good to go. You choose the dollar amount, we go to the salt/spice nook and go to town!

*This is a gift, we will remove the prices!

name: Guero y Maria Al Pastor Spice Bomb, 50g 2pk
description:
Güero y María started in 2008 with a simple idea: to make salsa just like the one we grew up eating - no shortcuts, no filters. They were at a local market, just having fun, selling a few jars of homemade sauce and seeing what happened. What happened was this: people kept coming back. To this day, all their products are still made with love and care in Quincy, WA, every batch roasted, mixed, and bottled with the same care as day one.

Birria is a traditional Mexican stew from the state of Jalisco, made with slow-cooked and tender meat in a rich, red chile broth called consomé. While traditionally made with goat, modern versions often use beef or lamb. Güero & María’s Birria Spice Blend (2 Pack). Crafted from real, ground ingredients, this ‘birria bomb’ makes cooking rich, flavorful birria effortless!

name: Le Saunier de Camargue Fleur de Sel, 125g
description: Fleur de Sel de Camargue is hand raked and harvested in France. Only the premium, top layer of the salt bed is used. Each container is sealed with a cork top and signed by the salt raker who harvested it. Ideal for seasoning all types of food, this crunchy salt is best used for finishing just before the food is served.

name: Maldon Sea Salt Flakes, 240g
description: Master salt makers for well over 100 years, Maldon is loved by chefs and shoppers the world over. Hand-harvested to preserve its distinctively soft and flaky texture, this sea salt has a fresh clean flavor with a bright piquancy. Absent of the bitterness that some salts can leave, it is the perfect finishing salt.

name: San Juan Island Sea Salt, 6oz
description: There are only two ingredients in San Juan Island Sea Salt - sunshine and seawater. This salt is a true reflection of the waters of Puget Sound. Rich with all the minerals the Sound has to offer, you will be reminded of the place from which it came every time you use it. Rich and briny, made with love in Friday Harbor, Washington!

name: Vignalta Sea Salt with Herbs, 200g
description: This herbed salt has a very committed following among our customers. For most who try it, they wonder how they ever got along without it. It is made by the Italian wine producer Vignalta in the Colli Euganei in Northeast Italy. Fresh (not dried) rosemary, sage, black pepper and garlic are added to Sicilian sea salt, allowing the aromatic oils of the fresh herbs & garlic to be preserved in the salt. The result is a salt with far more flavor than others that are infused with dull, dried herbs. Perfect on grilled meats, tossed with cooked vegetables, in dressings, marinades and rubs.

name: Esprit du Sel Fleur de Sel, 160g
description: Established in 1986 to preserve and promote the French salt marsh heritage, Esprit du Sel produces authentic, rare and traditional Fleur de Sel. Harvested from the clear waters off the Island of Re on the Atlantic coast of France, this salt tastes just like the sea from which it came. Intense, flavorful and reminiscent of tiny snow flakes, it is perfect for finishing vegetables, steak, fish or pasta.

name: The San Juan Sixer
tagline: 6 San Juan Sea Salt varieties to bring the flavor!
description: This is the six pack that isn't gone in an evening and won't keep you from driving home. The folks at San Juan quite literally flavor the lives of the customers & staff at DeLaurenti. Their wide range of classic and uniquely flavored salts & seasonings will rush to your aid when flavoring everything from your perfectly grilled steak to your popcorn on movie night. This gift brings the flavor in a big way to whoever is lucky enough to receive it! We chose our Top 6 customer favorites - hard to exclude any of them! You get...Classic Sea Salt, Popcorn Seasoning, Lemon Pepper, Daily Grind (melange of salt/pepper/spice in a grinder), Burger & Steak Blend & French Fry Seasoning!

name: Maldon Sea Salt Tub, 1.4kg
description: Master salt makers for well over 100 years, Maldon is loved by chefs and shoppers the world over. Hand-harvested to preserve its distinctively soft and flaky texture, this sea salt has a fresh clean flavor with a bright piquancy. Absent of the bitterness that some salts can leave, it is the perfect finishing salt. Go big with the tub or go home.

name: Maldon Wild Roasted Garlic Salt, 100g
description: Master salt makers for well over 100 years, Maldon is loved by chefs and shoppers the world over. Hand-harvested to preserve its distinctively soft and flaky texture, this sea salt has a fresh clean flavor with a bright piquancy. With the addition of wild roasted garlic, this salt will transform your prior perception of "garlic salt." It has the warm, muted flavor of roasted garlic that make it perfect for finishing grilled meats & vegetables.

name: San Juan Island BBQ Blend, 4.5oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

Not only do they make great salt, they also make great seasonings! This BBQ blend has a sweet and smoky aroma, and brings the richness of the grill indoors. It is slow cooked BBQ sauce in dry form - deep, smoky & sweet. Perfect for pulled pork, grilled chicken & deviled eggs.

name: San Juan Island Black Pepper Grinder, 2oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

What goes with salt besides everything? The easy answer is pepper. This pepper grinder is perfect for those times when you just need good old fashioned aromatic black pepper. Filled with the highest quality Malabar Organic Black Peppercorns, it is easy to use and refillable! Great for camping, keeping in your backpack, purse or pocket!

name: San Juan Island Burger & Steak Blend, 4.25oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

A surprise hit on fried eggs, this blend is more dexterous than its name implies. Subtle spice, warm smoke, and a burst of garlic make this your go-to flavor enhancer for burgers, steak, braises and chops!

name: San Juan Island Daily Grind, 1.9oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

This is your everyday flavor facilitator. This grinder features the deep mineral saltiness of hand harvested crystals, plus a confetti of delicious herbs. A pleasure for the mouth and a treat for the eyes. It is salty & garlicky with just the right hint of spiciness. Perfect for buttered English muffins, sandwiches and seafood!

name: San Juan Island Dill Pickle Salt, 4oz
description: San Juan Island Sea Salt starts with two basic ingredients - sunshine and seawater. The salt itself is a true reflection of the waters of Puget Sound. Rich with all the minerals the Sound has to offer, you will be reminded of the place from which it came every time you use it. This salt is an homage to one of their favorite foods! It's a tangy, dilly, zesty, garlicky salt with just the right magic to give you the feeling of crunching into perfect dill pickle.

name: San Juan Island Everything but the Bagel Blend, 3oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

This blend has all the nutty, crunchy, savory goodness, minus the bagel! Doctor up salads, cottage cheese and fish filets with this textural powerhouse. Inspired by many a morning enjoying a steaming mug of coffee and a freshly toasted bagel, it is at once chewy, crunchy & slightly nutty with a punch of garlic. Add it to Panko as a coating for chicken tenders, sprinkle on homemade bread or shake over coleslaw!

name: San Juan Island French Fry Seasoning, 4.25oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

There's almost nothing better than a perfectly seasoned, crispy French fry. San Juan Island created this salt blend as the ultimate companion to the golden fried potato. Salty, but not overpoweringly so. Sweet, but just a hint. Spicy, but mild enough for all palettes. Try this on your next spud!

name: San Juan Island Friday Harbor Seafood Blend, 3.75oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

This all purpose seafood blend delights with just the right balance of spice and tang. Enhances the delicate flavors of fish, shrimp and crab without overpowering. It tastes like the bountiful waters of the Salish Sea and summertime seafood grilling. It is uniquely peppery with hints of fresh garden herbs, and a lemony zing. Perfect for roasted halibut, pan fried shrimp and fresh oysters!

name: San Juan Island Garlic & Friends Blend, 3.9oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

A cut-above the classic garlic salt, this blend brings a flavor spectrum from the far corners of the allium family. Use it on every dish you'd normally use garlic on. It is beautifully pungent, mildly sweet, and accented with delicately aged black garlic. The gang is all here!

name: San Juan Island Kimchi Salt, 3.5oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

This blend has the characteristic taste of Kimchi that sings brightly by way of authentic Gochugaru peppers, ginger and garlic. No brainer on your Ramen noodle salad, soft boiled eggs, and French fries!

name: San Juan Island Lemon Pepper Blend, 4.5oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

Lemon and pepper are greater than the sum of their parts. This popular seasoning duo comes to its highest potential in this zingy blend of citrus and spice. Perfect for your grilled salmon, cottage cheese or chicken piccata.

name: San Juan Island Madrona Smoked Sea Salt, 6oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

The Pacific Madrona (Arbutus menziesii) is a beautiful native tree that grows along the West coast on rocky slopes and in forest clearings. It's an exceptionally hard wood that is the perfect ingredient for cold smoking San Juan's salt over two days. Use this salt for adding depth of flavor to sauces, soups and for bringing the flavor of the BBQ inside.

name: San Juan Island Organic Salt & Pepper Grinder, 2.5oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

This s a very handy companion. Two best friends, now under one roof! This classic seasoning combo comes to new life in an easy to use, easy to refill grinder!

name: San Juan Island Popcorn Blend, 3oz
description: San Juan Island Sea Salt starts with two basic ingredients - sunshine and seawater. The salt itself is a true reflection of the waters of Puget Sound. Rich with all the minerals the Sound has to offer, you will be reminded of the place from which it came every time you use it. Believe it or not, San Juan's popcorn blend is their most popular product, maybe because it's great on a lot more things than just popcorn. Try a pinch on grilled vegetables, eggs, pasta or anything else you might find on your plate! Made with nutritional yeast and a dash of herbs & spice, it's nutty, cheesy and also vegan!

name: San Juan Island Reserve Sea Salt, 5oz
description: Most of San Juan Island's salt forms at a crystal size much too large for straight consumption, meaning they have to grind and sift it to make it ready for the plate. But, scattered within their beds are crystals that have formed with a perfect size and a striking beauty. Delicate and sparkly. Flaky and light. Ready for use without any grinding or crushing. For years they have called this sea salt their North Star but could never find a way to reliably produce it. Now they have. Introducing San Juan Island's Reserve Salt!

name: San Juan Island Roman Blend, 3oz
description: San Juan Island Sea Salt starts with two basic ingredients - sunshine and seawater. The salt itself is a true reflection of the waters of Puget Sound. Rich with all the minerals the Sound has to offer, you will be reminded of the place from which it came every time you use it. Blend this salt with garlic, oregano, basil, marjoram & sage and you have an Italian inspired seasoning that is perfect on ripe tomatoes, in your marinara sauce or incorporated into unsalted butter for an amazing spread on grilled bread.

name: San Juan Island San Juan Island Blend, 3.75oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

This go-to herb blend offers a rich, savory answer to the all-purpose season salt. Tasty enough to be named after the beloved San Juan Island, this blend might become your newest pantry staple. It is garlicky & peppery with a hint of celery and a dash of heat. Among other things, perfect for garlic bread, tuna salad & corn on the cob.

name: San Juan Island Scorpion Salt, 4.5oz
description: San Juan Island Sea Salt starts with two basic ingredients - sunshine and seawater. The salt itself is a true reflection of the waters of Puget Sound. Rich with all the minerals the Sound has to offer, you will be reminded of the place from which it came every time you use it. This product is a celebration of spice, and of the continually evolving race to find the world's hottest pepper. This is their sea salt mixed with organically grown Scorpion Chili Peppers. For a while the Scorpion Chili, from Trinidad and Tobago, was ranked as the world's hottest pepper.

name: San Juan Island Smokehouse Blend, 4.5oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

The folks at San Juan Island salt just can't get enough of the smoky magic of Madrona wood. This time they've smoked their favorite alliums alongside crunchy sesame seeds and their signature sea salt. Truly unique! It has The caramel, smoky goodness of madrona wood. This coastal, red barked tree's beauty is matched only by its distinctive flavor. Perfect for Asian coleslaw, roasted beans & pork rib chops!

name: San Juan Island Solar Powered Sea Salt, 8oz
description: There are only two ingredients in San Juan Island Sea Salt - sunshine and seawater. This salt is a true reflection of the waters of Puget Sound. Rich with all the minerals the Sound has to offer, you will be reminded of the place from which it came every time you use it. Rich and briny, made with love in Friday Harbor, Washington!

name: San Juan Island Taco Blend, 4.5oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

This salt blend is mildly spicy yet robust in flavor. Use this blend in chili or other tomato-based soups. Or try as a finishing touch to your favorite baked potato recipe. Or...spoiler alert...on your tacos!

name: San Juan Ramen Blend, 3.75oz
description:
Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt.

This blend delivers an elevated experience from your favorite ramen seasoning packets. It combines the salty goodness of delicate nori, a zing of ginger and the umami power of shiitake mushroom and MSG. Perfect for your Israeli couscous, baked salmon or broccolini.

name: Maldon Smoked Sea Salt Flakes, 125g
description: Master salt makers for well over 100 years, Maldon is loved by chefs and shoppers the world over. Hand-harvested to preserve the distinctive flakey texture, this cold smoked sea salt adds a subtle smokiness that does not overpower. Use with fish, poultry, in sauces, salsas, soups and marinades.

name: Mancha-Oro Spanish Saffron, 0.8g
description: The La Mancha region in Spain is renowned for it's high quality saffron. Famous for its title as the most expensive spice by weight in the world, it is made from the dried threads of the Saffron Crocus flower. Traditionally used in Risotto alla Milanese, seafood paella and a variety of sauces, it adds distinctive flavor, aroma and color to all your recipes.

name: New York Shuk Ground Sumac Berries, 2oz
description:
New York Shuk is a maker of handcrafted Middle Eastern pantry staples. The word shuk means "market" in Hebrew, and for Ron and Leetal, the marketplace represents the center of a community - the meeting point where commerce and culture come together. They try to bring this communal energy, as well as the freshness of a bustling outdoor market to everything they do at New York Shuk.

The sumac bush, native to the Middle East, produces ruby-hued berries. These berries are dried then ground which produces a versatile spice with a pleasantly fruity aroma and notable tangy, lemony flavor that shines when sprinkled over a dish just before serving.

name: New York Shuk Herby Harissa, 2oz
description:
New York Shuk is a maker of handcrafted Middle Eastern pantry staples. The word shuk means "market" in Hebrew, and for Ron and Leetal, the marketplace represents the center of a community - the meeting point where commerce and culture come together. They try to bring this communal energy, as well as the freshness of a bustling outdoor market to everything they do at New York Shuk.

Their authentic Harissa spice is blended with the finest Mediterranean herbs, delivering an earthy, aromatic edge to your favorite dishes.

name: New York Shuk Ras El Hanout, 2oz
description:
New York Shuk is a maker of handcrafted Middle Eastern pantry staples. The word shuk means "market" in Hebrew, and for Ron and Leetal, the marketplace represents the center of a community - the meeting point where commerce and culture come together. They try to bring this communal energy, as well as the freshness of a bustling outdoor market to everything they do at New York Shuk.

Translating to "head of the shop," Ras El Hanout was often a combination of all the best spices into one. This is a pantry staple featuring the warming flavors ever-present in the kitchens of Morocco. A must-have!

name: New York Shuk Rosey Harissa, 2oz
description:
New York Shuk is a maker of handcrafted Middle Eastern pantry staples. The word shuk means "market" in Hebrew, and for Ron and Leetal, the marketplace represents the center of a community - the meeting point where commerce and culture come together. They try to bring this communal energy, as well as the freshness of a bustling outdoor market to everything they do at New York Shuk.

Their special Rosey Harissa is skillfully blended using delicate rose petals and the best sun-dried chili peppers, adding a fragrant hit to your favorite dishes. Mild in heat, big on flavor!

name: New York Shuk Shawarma Blend, 2oz
description:
New York Shuk is a maker of handcrafted Middle Eastern pantry staples. The word shuk means "market" in Hebrew, and for Ron and Leetal, the marketplace represents the center of a community - the meeting point where commerce and culture come together. They try to bring this communal energy, as well as the freshness of a bustling outdoor market to everything they do at New York Shuk.

Meet their Middle Eastern pantry in a jar! Inspired by the bold flavors of shawarma, the Middle Eastern street food classic of meat cooked on a rotating spit, this is your go-to spice for adding a piquant flavor to everything from vegetables and fish to grilled meats.

name: New York Shuk Za'atar, 2oz
description:
New York Shuk is a maker of handcrafted Middle Eastern pantry staples. The word shuk means "market" in Hebrew, and for Ron and Leetal, the marketplace represents the center of a community - the meeting point where commerce and culture come together. They try to bring this communal energy, as well as the freshness of a bustling outdoor market to everything they do at New York Shuk.

Za’atar is the gateway spice to the Middle Eastern pantry. Their version, based on an ancient Jerusalem recipe, uses traditional za’atar leaves, sumac, sesame and olive oil for an intriguing and versatile blend that earns its place at the table during breakfast, lunch and dinner.

name: Matiz Piment d'Espelette, 45g
description: Highly prized in the Basque region of France, Matiz Piment d’Espelette offers a mildly sweet-spicy heat with aromatic hints of fruit and dried hay. This unique dried red pepper from Espelette enhances any dish - from French ham omelets to grilled fish, sausages, and even desserts!

name: Ritrovo Selections Truffle & Salt, 100g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this is the original truffle salt! Award-winning and intensely aromatic, it is a blend of Italian black truffle and Adriatic sea salt. Incredibly versatile, it is great on everything from pasta to popcorn to filet mignon. Reach for this salt any time you are in need of the earthy flavor of black truffle!

name: Villa Jerada Aleppo, 60g
description: Imagine a chile pepper walking through an orange grove, and you have the flavor of dried Aleppo pepper - an essential, prized ingredient known for its mild heat and burst of fruitiness and a go-to ingredient in Levantine cuisine. Its warm complexity makes it a brilliant solo player for seasoning grilled meats and stews, while also playing nice with others: mix it with cumin and cinnamon for a simple spice rub. Or add a little verve to your dessert game by sprinkling it on fresh peaches or, yes, even ice cream. Aleppo also pairs well with grilled meats, soups, tomatoes, salads and tastes delicious when used as a topping on pizza, and crunchy potato chips.

name: VIlla Jerada Dukkah, 50g
description: Dukkah, a versatile Egyptian condiment with a name that means to pound, produces a coarsely ground mixture of aromatic herbs, spices and hazelnuts. It compliments dips, roasted vegetables, meats, and stews or best simply served in the traditional way with hard boiled eggs olive oil, and bread. Made with oregon hazelnuts, coriander, cumin, cayenne, salt & sesame seeds.

name: Villa Jerada Kefta Rub, 50g
description: Villa Jerada's Kefta Rub adds a fragrant touch to meat that's reminiscent of street stalls, cafes, & dinner tables that stretch across the Moroccan landscape like a simple but complex favorite shared by locals and remembered by the traveler. Perfect for meatball tagines, braises and grills, it is a blend of cumin, paprika, morita pepper, coriander, cinnamon, mint & cayenne pepper.

name: Villa Jerada Moruno Rub, 50goz
description: Moruno, a popular and beloved Spanish blend with a Moroccan influence, embodies the flavor and culture prevalent on the tapas scene. Villa Jerada's recipe adds a rich layering of aromatic and savory complexity to meats and stews. Perfect for lamb, meat skewers and savory tagines with it's combination of saffron, cumin, coriander, fennel, black pepper, saffron, dried oregano, thyme, pimento, turmeric.

name: Villa Jerada Ras el Hanout, 60g
description: The undisputed crown jewel of Moroccan and North African spice, Ras el Hanout translates to "top shelf," but we strongly recommend you keep this jar within arm’s length. The best of both home cooking and expertise, you’re holding Villa Jerada's family recipe tweaked and perfected by their spice merchant in the Casablanca Marché aux épices, Omar. So much greater than the sum of its parts, Ras el Hanout is traditional for use in Mrouzia (Moroccan lamb confit), but use it well and often on grilled chicken, in tomato soup, and on any and all roasted vegetables!

name: Villa Jerada Saffron, 1g
description: Saffron is famous for its title as the most expensive spice by weight in the world. Made from the dried threads of the Saffron Crocus flower, it is traditionally used in Risotto alla Milanese, seafood paella and a variety of sauces. A little goes a long way, adding bold, savory flavor and a distinct golden color to all your recipes.

name: Villa Jerada Shawarma, 1.76oz
description: Shawarma means to turn, a Levantine method of marinating and cooking grilled meats throughout the middle east. Villa Jerada's recipe is based a Syrian family recipe which is hand blended in small batches to bring out the warm, aromatic and bright flavor of this popular mix. Use on grilled meats, with roasted chickpeas or cauliflower, mixed in with yogurt as a sauce accompaniment, or simply sprinkle over popcorn. It is a combination of paprika, onion powder, nutmeg, cumin, bay leaf, cardamom, garlic powder, ginger, coriander, cayenne, cinnamon, all spice, cloves, turmeric, sumac, black and white pepper

name: Villa Jerada Sumac, 60g
description: There’s just something about sumac. Savory, citrusy, that deep red/purple hue: it's hot summer in a jar. And versatile as the day is long. In your za'atar, yogurt, lamb, chicken and fish, vinaigrettes, marinades, atop fruit, yogurt or even ice cream!

name: Villa Jerada Urfa Biber, 50g
description: Urfa Biber tells the story of a mild red pepper that’s dried by the sun, wrapped tight to sweat, and transformed by the moon. Dark purple hues dried of the earth to a raisin like perfection adding a complex approachable smoke and heat.Pairs well with pungent cheese, robust vegetables, braised meats and salads

name: Walkerswood Jerk Seasoning, 280g
description: This stuff is amazing. Walkerswood sources all their ingredients fresh from local farmers across the Jamaica. This traditional jerk seasoning is made with scallions, scotch bonnet peppers, allspice and nutmeg. Use as a rub or marinade with chicken, lamb, burgers, pork, fish and vegetables. The spice is intense, so start conservatively and work up from there. Make the jar last even longer by adding a little olive oil to thin the mixture before applying.

name: Michele Ferrante Hot Controne Pepper, 40g
description: This pepper powder is a mracle. Air-dried, hand-ground Campania,. it is zesty yet nutty in flavor with notes of wood smoke and plenty of heat. Perfect for pasta, beans & proteins.

name: Momofuku Savory Salt, 3.4oz
description: Momofuku Seasoned Salt is the result of 10 years of flavor research in the Momofuku Culinary Lab. Savory Seasoned Salt is supercharged salt and pepper. It mixes kosher salt with garlic, tamari, kelp, and mushroom powder. Perfect on grilled steaks and vegetables!

name: Momofuku Spicy Salt, 3.4oz
description: Momofuku Seasoned Salt is the result 10 years of flavor research in the Momofuku Culinary Lab. Spicy is a flash of heat. It blends their Savory base with gochugaru, cayenne pepper, and dried chilies. Perfect for using on shrimp, stewed meats, and ripe mango!

name: Momofuku Tingly Salt, 3.4oz
description: Momofuku Seasoned Salt is the result 10 years of flavor research in the Momofuku Culinary Lab. Tingly is a jolt of flavor. It is a blend of our Savory base with Sichuan peppercorns and citrus. Perfect on fish, popcorn, and roasted vegetables.

name: Aux Anysetiers du Roy Herbes de Provence, 28g
description: Herbes de Provence, or Provençal herbs, is a traditional blend of aromatic herbs that flourish in hills of southern France during the hot summer months. There are many variations to this traditional blend depending on who you ask or what they are cooking. In this case, these traditional crocks are hand-packed with thyme, basil, savory, fennel and lavender flowers. Herbs de Provence is a great addition to virtually any Mediterranean dish, including lamb, beef, chicken, fish, roasted vegetables, salads or even pizza sauce.

name: El Rey de la Vera Hot Paprika, 75g
description: El Rey de la Vera represents four generations of paprika producers. Smoked pimenton, or paprika, is a staple of the Mediterranean diet and is used to give both color and flavor to many traditional dishes. Rey de la Vera’s unique drying process over an oak wood burning stove gives the paprika it's distinctive aroma, flavor and color. Their hot paprika is made from a mixture of Guindilla and Jarandilla peppers. The former providing the heat, and the latter lending it's vibrant color and mild flavor.

name: El Rey de la Vera Sweet Paprika, 75g
description: El Rey de la Vera represents four generations of paprika producers. Smoked pimenton, or paprika, is a staple of the Mediterranean diet and is used to give both color and flavor to many traditional dishes. Rey de la Vera’s unique drying process over an oak wood burning stove gives the paprika it's distinctive aroma, flavor and color. Their sweet paprika is made from the small, round Nora Pepper, which is native to the Valencia region of Spain.

name: Esprit du Sel Grey Sea Salt, 500g
description: Established in 1986 to preserve and promote the French salt marsh heritage, Esprit du Sel produces authentic, rare and traditional Fleur de Sel. Harvested from the clear waters off the Island of Re on the Atlantic coast of France, this salt tastes just like the sea from which it came. This grey salt is neither treated or washed, so it remains rich with minerals. Perfect for salt-encrusted roasting recipes, it's rugged textured, briny crystals also make an excellent base for rubs, roasts, marinades and soups.

name: Grasslands & Barbecue All-Purpose Seasoning, 227g
description:
Grasslands Barbecue is a highly acclaimed Texas-style barbecue food truck and catering company based in Hood River, Oregon.

Their Go-To rub for beef, pork, chicken, and veggies. They especially love pairing this with tri-tip, potatoes, IPAs you can actually see through, popcorn, and essentially everything.

This rub contains no salt because they prefer to salt separately and ahead of time, for depth of favor and personal preference.

name: India Tree Tellicherry Pepper, 4.5oz
description: Located in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood, India Tree offers an exciting assortment of quality ingredients for cooking and baking, ranging from pantry essentials to party decoratifs. Pepper fact: black pepper is the berry of an evergreen vine native to India. The berries, growing in long clusters, are harvested while they are still green, then sun-dried until they shrivel and turn brownish-black. Tellicherry are the largest, the plumpest, the most pungent and the most aromatic of all black peppers. Get a good pepper grinder, fill & repeat.

name: La Baleine Coarse Sea Salt, 750g
description: La Baleine sea salt has been produced by Salins-du-Midi in the Aigues-Mortes saltworks, in Camargue, France since 1856. This coarse sea salt is great for rubs, roasting & finishing. The course crystals provide more texture than their fine counterpart, yet they are soft and dissolve quickly giving a burst of clean, light salty flavor with each bite.

name: La Baleine Fine Sea Salt, 750g
description: La Baleine sea salt has been produced by Salins-du-Midi in the Aigues-Mortes saltworks, in Camargue, France since 1856. This finely ground sea salt is perfect to use instead of traditional table salt in baking, cooking or blending. The super-fine texture penetrates deep into foods and readily dissolves.

name: Nong's Khao Man Gai Sauce, 12oz
description: Originally from Bangkok, Thailand, Nong moved to Portland in 2003 with $70 and two suitcases. Shortly after, she opened a small food cart designed to sell just one thing: Khao Man Gai. This traditional Thai chicken dish consists of poached chicken with Thai aromatics, rice and broth - it is served with a sauce made from fermented soy bean puree and mixed with garlic, ginger, thai chilies, vinegar and sugar. Garnished with a few pieces of cucumber & cilantro, it is a Thai staple. This is her handmade sauce, and the only sauce you can use to replicate this amazing dish. Its use does not stop there, though. It is also great as a marinade or a sauce with chicken, pork or fish.

name: Omnivore Limone Salt, 6oz
description: Omnivore was founded by Angelo Garro, a master blacksmith, passionate hunter, forager, cook and Slow Food icon widely known through his role in Michael Pollan’s The Omnivore’s Dilemma. His Omnivore Salt, a spiced salt blend described by Alice Waters as “indispensable,” draws on knowledge Garro picked up while foraging as a youth in Sicily. Omnivore Limone Salt is a zesty, herbaceous, aromatic citrus and sea salt blend ideal for poultry, fish, and spring vegetables. Its delicate balance of herbs and lemon zest adds aromatic and herbaceous flavors to your recipes. Add this to your food before or during cooking to rehydrate the dried herbs and let their flavor infuse your recipes!

name: Omnivore Salt, 6oz
description: Omnivore was founded by Angelo Garro, a master blacksmith, passionate hunter, forager, cook and Slow Food icon widely known through his role in Michael Pollan’s The Omnivore’s Dilemma. His Omnivore Salt, a spiced salt blend described by Alice Waters as “indispensable,” draws on knowledge Garro picked up while foraging as a youth in Sicily. He learned the wonder of herbs like the wild fennel that grew around his childhood home, and spices like the chili peppers his grandmother hung to dry in her kitchen, when mixed with salt, give character to any food and make cooking simple. Omnivore Salt is an organic, well-balanced, earthy, peppery, delicate picante sea salt blend. Just a pinch of the versatile cooking (or finishing) salt will add balance to your recipes and bring out the natural flavor of your food.

name: Queen Majesty Ancho Chili Powder, 5oz
description: Limited edition Manzano Serrano hot sauce, hand made in NYC. Try the Ancho hot sauce powder!

name: Rancho Gordo Oregano Indio, .4oz
description: Rancho Gordo's Oregano Indio, sometimes known as Oreja de Raton, or Mouse's Ear, is less citrusy than the standard Mexican oregano and there's an indescribable earthiness that makes it infectious. Put it on almost everything.

name: Rancho Gordo Stardust Dipping Powder, 2.4oz
description: Rancho Gordo Stardust is a mixture of medium-heat dry New Mexican chiles and herbs and spices. It is a blend of dried chiles, crystallized lime, brown sugar, sea salt, and Mexican oregano. Dip your raw, fresh cut fruits and vegetables into Stardust for a peppy zap of chile and citrus, a perfect snack!

name: Tutto Calabria Bruschetta, 180g
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world! Made with dried Calabrian peppers, oregano, garlic and basil, all you need is a can of good Italian tomatoes and some heat to simmer and you have a warmly spiced, herbaceous sauce for pasta. Also great to season soup, or grilled meats.

name: Tutto Calabria Calabrian Oregano, 1oz
description: Calabrian oregano leaves are just different - more aromatic & more flavorful. They are cultivated by local farmers who follow practices handed down from generation to generation. This oregano is one of the most used aromatic herbs in Italy, particularly in the South. Perfect for pizza, sauces, dressings, grilled chicken & fish.

name: Tutto Calabria Chili Flake, 250g
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world! These famous bright red crushed Calabrian peppers will make any recipe hot! Great on sandwiches, pizza and mixed into dressings, dips and sauces.

name: Tutto Calabria Dried Oregano, 40g
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world. A staple of Italian cuisine, oregano is one of those herbs that is more flavorful dried, than fresh. Hand-harvested from the hot, mountainous region of Calabria, this wild oregano has unlimited uses in the kitchen. Ideal for sauces, pizza, meats, vegetables, and spicy foods.

name: Tutto Calabria Hot Chili Powder, 110g
description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. This chili powder will amp up the spice in any dish! It is fragrant, sweet, and yes….spicy. These peppers are traditionally dried, then powdered. Soon to become your next go-to pantry staple!

name: Tutto Calabria Spaghettata, 2.82oz
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world. This spice mixture is made with dried Calabrian peppers, parsley, garlic, dried tomatoes and salt. Packed with flavor and already portioned, just drop it in your pot of simmering tomatoes, let it cook, and you have a perfect marinara sauce. It is also great combines with some olive oil for dipping, or used in rubs and marinades.
